long_description:
Join the perfect Wellness Morning. ☕️ Reset with Outdoor Yoga, Cold & Hot Plunge Truck, B12, Chiropractic Scans, Botox & Permanent Jewelry!

About this Event

Alchemy Aesthetics + Med Spa is joining forces with Plungehouse Leawood—along with a curated collective of our favorite local wellness brands—to bring you the ultimate mind-body reset!
We’ve got high-vibe outdoor yoga, a contrast therapy plunge truck pulling up, free B12 shots, free chiropractic body scans, Botox, handcrafted espresso, permanent jewelry and chances to win prizes like Microneedling, Alo apparel and a year of Botox all colliding in one space.
You can experience any and all of our activities, or simply show up, hang out, and enjoy the vibes!🧘
Choose your Ticket Slot to ensure a steady flow of participants and keep the lines short (especially at the plunge truck), we are offering two separate yoga sessions. Please sign up for one of the following three ticket options:
YOGA Session 1YOGA Session 2General Admission (No Yoga)We highly encourage you to explore and participate in all of our other amazing activities around your selected yoga time slot!🌟 What to Expect
Outside in the Parking Lot: Cold & Hot Plunge Truck, Yoga, Free B12, and the Coffee Bar.Inside the Building: Botox, Permanent Jewelry, and Free Chiropractic Body Scans.⚠️ Important Rules & Things to Bring:
Bring Your Own Gear: Please bring your own yoga mat and towel, as these will not be provided.Changing Facilities: If the hot and cold plunge is on your list, a dedicated outdoor changing tent will be set up right next to the truck. You may plunge in your activewear or a swimsuit and use the tents as needed.Strict Safety Rule: Due to limited space and safety precautions, entering the building while wet to change is strictly prohibited. Please use the outdoor changing facilities.🚗 Parking Information
